level_2_5_parameter_clean.what_is_clean: The prediction model never trains on it (train_noseed_model filters y < max_year) and every parametric knob is swept on 2011-2025 only.
level_2_5_parameter_clean.why_not_level_1: The candidate-family set was pruned using aggregates that included it: scripts/mc_pool_backtest.py:4026-4042 records family (d) removed 2026-05-03 ('selected in only 1/15 years') and family (e) removed 2026-05-16, where a 15-season window is BACKTEST_YEARS = 2011-2026 excluding 2020. The 2026 tournament ended that April, so its outcome was known. CONTAMINATED_EVAL_YEARS was not added until 2026-09-09 (a3fb412). The removed families no longer exist as code, so those decisions cannot be re-run on a 2026-free window.

holdout.no_historical_holdout: 2011-2025 were all both trained on (as priors for later seasons) and searched over, so none is a holdout. 2008-2010 are training-only and never evaluated, which is not the same thing. 2020 has no tournament. A never-touched holdout cannot be manufactured retroactively; it can only be sequestered going forward.

holdout_evaluation.evidence_level_explanation: 2026 is NOT a Level-1 holdout and cannot be made one. The candidate-family set was pruned using aggregates that included it: scripts/mc_pool_backtest.py:4026-4042 records family (d) removed 2026-05-03 ('selected in only 1/15 years') and family (e) removed 2026-05-16, where a 15-season window is BACKTEST_YEARS = 2011-2026 excluding 2020. The 2026 tournament ended in April 2026, so its outcome was known. CONTAMINATED_EVAL_YEARS, which now strips 2026 from aggregates, was not added until 2026-09-09 (a3fb412) -- four months after those prunings. The removed families no longer exist as code, so those decisions cannot be re-run on a 2026-free window. What IS true is that the prediction model never trains on it (train_noseed_model's walk-forward filter is y < max_year) and the parametric knobs are derived on 2011-2025 only. That makes it parameter-clean, not untouched.

circular_modes.fixed_blendA100_r35: alpha=1.0 is pure seed_rp, and the referee is seed_pw -- graded by its own source. Its alpha sweep shows the signature: .0879 / .1050 / .1086 / .1036 then a 1.8pp jump to .1214 at exactly the endpoint that coincides with the referee.

multiplicity.decision_rule: pre-registered in the module docstring before this ran
multiplicity.measurement: multiplicity correction over the surviving strategy family
multiplicity.residual_not_corrected: This corrects over the strategy family that still exists in ALL_MODES. It does NOT correct over the search's history: candidate families that were built, measured, found worse and deleted (scripts/mc_pool_backtest.py:4026-4042 records two, with dates 2026-05-03 and 2026-05-16 and the numbers that justified each removal). Those specifications are gone from the code, so no resampling scheme can restore them to the family. Carried as removed_after_measuring entries in src.governance.pool_rdof_audit.REGISTRY.

recommendations: DRIFT: none. 32/44 entries verified against live code (73% coverage); 12 are inline literals with no importable binding and cannot be machine-checked.

DoF RATIO: 13 degrees of freedom spent against 14 independent seasons = 0.93 per season. That is close to one free choice per observation, i.e. a design with roughly as many tuning decisions as data points, and it needs no external benchmark to be a problem: at this ratio the in-sample fit of the search is uninformative about out-of-sample performance almost regardless of what the fit is. Only time fixes the denominator -- one season per year.

SENSITIVITY: after flatness discounting, 12.0 effective DoF (0.86 per season). Knobs measured flat cost ~0; unmeasured knobs are counted at full weight because an unmeasured knob cannot be assumed harmless.

CIRCULARITY: 4 knob(s) were set because of their effect on this metric and 3 candidate family/families were deleted for scoring worse on the evaluation seasons. No resampling scheme can correct for the removed ones -- their code is gone. This is the irreducible core of finding H2.

MULTIPLICITY: meta_region_poolaware aggregate P(1st) 0.1200 vs baseline 0.0399; best-of-family p = 0.0005999400059994001, stepdown-adjusted p = 0.0005999400059994001 over 78 modes. VERDICT survives_correction.
HOLDOUT: Level 1 = [2027] (untouched); Level 2.5 = 2026 (evaluated=True). No historical season is a holdout and none can be made one retroactively.

registry.derivation: Whether pool size reaches bracket construction below 51 entries. The pre-registered rule required both a mean gain and 9 of 14 seasons; adopting on the mean alone would have been a forking path on the very metric H2 is about. sensitivity.design_note: One-at-a-time from the production setting, not a full factorial: a factorial over these four axes is ~200 cells and several days, and the question asked here is whether any single unjustified knob moves the headline. Interaction effects are therefore NOT measured and this cannot rule them out.

excluded_seasons.2026: parameter-clean holdout -- deriving parameters here would contaminate it

sensitivity.measurement: one-at-a-time specification curve over un-provenanced tier-3 knobs
sensitivity.not_adopted: No sweep optimum is adopted into the code by this script, deliberately. Adopting the best cell would itself be a new researcher degree of freedom -- exactly what the deleted rdof_audit.adopt_sensitivity_optima() did wrong. Any adoption is a separate decision requiring a SPEC_VERSION bump.
sensitivity.threshold_basis: 1.5pp is one season-level standard error on the headline (audit H1)
